# Configuration reference

Every resource envelope an embedder can set, with the default construction observed in source. Defaults are read from the source literal of the documented constructor, never duplicated by hand.

## `supersql.OpenOptions`

OpenOptions configures Open in the fixture.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Directory | string | none; required | Directory is the database directory. Open creates it when absent. |
| Compaction | CompactionConfig | zero value selects `neosepia.DefaultLimits()` | Compaction replaces the backend default limits when nonzero. |
| Clock | any | none; required | Clock is the certified time source borrowed by the database. |
| HistoricalReadOnly | bool | false | HistoricalReadOnly serves retained historical snapshots only. |

Open rejects an empty `Directory` with `ErrDirectoryRequired`, a nil or unavailable `Clock` with `ErrClockRequired`, and maps an incompatible directory layout to `*UpgradeRequired`. A nonzero `Compaction` replaces the whole backend envelope rather than merging field by field.

## `supersql.CompactionConfig`

`CompactionConfig` is a type alias of `neosepia.Limits`: the NeoSepia backend resource envelope covering resident handles, WAL, mutation and run preparation, read budgets and plan budgets. The zero value selects the defaults below; `neosepia.Open` rejects any zero bound or non-positive count, so a partially filled envelope is invalid rather than partially defaulted.
